proof: For each byte-identical image group g, a deterministic classifier must choose one class. Its maximum contribution to balanced accuracy is max_c n(g,c)/(4*N(c)). Summing over groups gives an upper bound; visually different groups may introduce additional difficulty.
interpretation: This is a constraint of the current combined four-class record protocol, not an assertion that any particular supplied label or prior-year study is incorrect. It does not establish a test-set ceiling. Labels, files, roles and primary scores are unchanged.
